reuse.why: Changes only getRangeAmount and getApproxAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which getPlannedAmount/getScheduledAmount and every server call site already go through.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified to Math.min and amount - threshold in the existing helpers.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the planned-amount helpers live.

scope.why: Two helper bodies, matching test updates, a release note and comment refreshes at the callers that described the old rule.

maintainability.why: A minimal, obviously correct edit to the single definition of the rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planned-amount sites (forecast-schedules, schedules/app, schedule-template, client via getScheduledAmount) use getPlannedAmount.
